t: This is Harris Girls' Academy East Dulwich, a secondary school and sixth form in the London Borough of Southwark. It converted to academy status in September 2006 and belongs to the Harris Federation, a not-for-profit group of schools. The founder is Philip Harris, Baron Harris of Peckham, an English businessman and politician. He is a prominent Conservative donor and former deputy chairman of the party's Board of Treasurers, though he supported Labour at the 2024 general election while keeping the Conservative Whip.
